A big announcement from Lexsi Labs: 

Lexsi Labs ( Lexsi Labs ), Cohere Labs ( Cohere ) and Hugging Face( Hugging Face ) are partnering on the Lexsi AI Safety and Alignment Hackathon, one of the biggest hackathon on post-training and AI Safety & Alignment. 

Nov 1 to 21, 2026. Online, free, open to builders worldwide.

Teams build real post-training pipelines:
- Models: open-weights Tiny Aya and Aya Expanse from Cohere Labs
- Tooling: six open-source Lexsi Labs toolkits (AlignTune, CuratorKIT, AuditKIT, SafeTune, CircuitKIT, AgentTune)
- Artifacts: models, adapters, logs and datasets hosted on Hugging Face

Three tracks: fine-tuning and data curation, AI red teaming and safety, agentic fine-tuning.

Each submission chains at least two toolkits and reports before-and-after metrics.

$30,000+ in prizes and credits, GPU credits for up to 800 teams, Demo Day for the top 20, and interviews at Lexsi Labs for standout builders.

Kickoff: Bengaluru, Oct 31, with an online option.

Registration starts today at: hackathon.lexsi.ai 

Thank you to Hugging Face and Cohere for building this with us.

 #LexsiLabs #Huggingface #Cohere #AISafetyhackathon #AIAlignmentHackathon #AIHackathon #Posttraining
